title: Some quick synthesis tests for videogames
author: ptitrainvaloin

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: Looks interesting! Would you be able to share how you made these?

replies.author: ptitrainvaloin
replies.body:
Thanks,
Graphics made with text to video, used words such as "walking toward Castle entrance from 2D side-view". Did not specify 8-bit or 16-bit videogames graphics as such prompts usually give worst results without LoRA.
Sound made with Audiocraft (melody), prompted some violin and other instruments in it.
